user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results within ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for ChatGPT search results; not used for training foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates safety and compliance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Visits landing pages submitted as ads to check compliance and relevance; not used for training.
user_agents.opt_out: Not specified in documentation.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content used to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches web pages triggered by user actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests and interactions via GPT Actions; not used for automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve web content at users' direction.
user_agents.scope: Content retrieved dynamically in response to user-initiated queries to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality and relevance for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed for search optimization and search response accuracy.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information to build Google search indexes and product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl image files for Google Images and search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and search features displaying images, logos, favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping including Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for product teams, internal research, and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content fetched for internal R&D without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Image fetching for internal research without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Video fetching for internal research without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Perform crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawling; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content use for training Gemini models and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models powering Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API, and Search grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet automatically.
user_agents.scope: Web search and data collection.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage access using robots.txt tags.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather information from the internet in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web search and data retrieval.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage access using robots.txt tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and generative AI training.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for Apple search, Siri, Spotlight, and AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models powering generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Determines whether crawled web data is used to train Apple foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of apps or websites shared across Meta family of apps.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Meta platforms to gather and display metadata.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance Meta AI accuracy, relevance, and citations.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content relevant to advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for training foundation AI models or improving products via indexing.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed directly or used for training foundation AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: User-requested links used to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: General web crawling to provide accurate information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Eligible content appears in search experiences like Alexa; does not train generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports live user actions and queries requiring up-to-date information.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web information for user actions; does not train generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Processes and extracts web crawl candidates for research and analysis datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: CCBot Disallow: / to robots.txt or use the opt-out registry.
